Based on the visual evidence provided in the images:

1.  **Which image (top or bottom) shows a small gold dot below the K?**
    The **top** image shows a small, distinct gold dot positioned directly below the left leg of the "K".

2.  **In which image does the fabric below the K look cleaner and more natural?**
    The **bottom** image looks cleaner and more natural below the letterform because it lacks the anomalous gold dot present in the top image, showing only the uninterrupted pattern of the navy fabric.

3.  **Any other difference between the two images?**
    Yes, there is a subtle difference in the **background pattern alignment**. If you look at the specific geometric shapes of the navy pattern surrounding the letter (particularly to the right of the right leg of the "K"), the lines and rectangles are shifted slightly differently between the two frames, indicating they are two distinct captures or crops rather than a simple edit of a single static file.
